newsitem.title: USA: NGC to build condensate terminal.
newsitem.headline: NGC to build condensate terminal.

text.p: NGC Oil Trading and Transportation Inc said it has begun construction on a condensate transportation and terminalling system to handle condensate volumes from the Johnson's Bayou area in Cameron Parish, La.

The NGC Corp subsidiary said it will construct a new barge-loading facility on the Intracoastal Waterway near Orange, Texas, and will convert an existing pipeline to condensate service. The pipeline extends from Johnson's Bayou to the new facility, which is expected to be in service during the first quarter of 1997.

The new facility will have 100,000 barrels of storage, and the ability to load more than 20,000 barrels per day of condensate to barges capable of handling abour 40,000 barrels, which is the maximum size that can move on the Intracoastal Waterway. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
